$description: Semantic tokens that do not vary by theme — typography, shape and motion. Split out so the theme files contain only what actually differs, and a reviewer comparing light against dark is looking at a diff of colour rather than a diff of everything.

font-numeric.$description: Tabular figures are mandatory for values, doses and identifiers. A proportional 1 in a column of results breaks the alignment that makes the column scannable.

duration-fast.$description: Decorative motion is prohibited on clinical surfaces. These durations exist for state changes a user initiated, not for drawing attention.

duration-identity-swap.$description: A patient change, applied to the whole identity block as one unit — never field by field. Staggering the fields lets a reader catch one patient's identifier beside another patient's name for roughly a tenth of a second, which is a wrong-patient hazard created by the animation rather than prevented by it.

duration-identity-reveal.$description: Break-the-glass on a sensitive record, and any field entering a row. Information animates in; it never animates out. A graceful exit means a stale value is still readable while it leaves.

duration-identity-escalate.$description: The disambiguation pass adding a date of birth or an identifier to a row that collided with another.

duration-alert.$description: Deliberately zero, and the one value in this file worth arguing about. An error or a wrong-patient block must be present the instant it is true; animating it in leaves a window in which a keystroke can still land on the form underneath it.

duration-skeleton-loop.$description: The only infinite animation the system permits. Anything else that loops on a clinical surface becomes furniture within a day, and then hides the one occasion it means something.
